name: geistm/adnet
title: GeistM Adnet
description: Advertise on the GeistM Adnet from an epistery session. The session's owner identity is the advertiser: each campaign deploys as its own contract, staked from the identity's treasury on a signer's own signature. Campaigns, links and headlines are sealed in the session; images come from the session's Files.
author: GeistM

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List this session's campaigns (drafts and deployed). Each comes back as {id, record} — record is the JSON of the campaign, opened with your key.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List this session's destination links. Each comes back as {id, record} — record is the JSON of the link, opened with your key.

tools.name: list_headlines
tools.description: List this session's headlines. Each comes back as {id, record} — record is the JSON of the headline, opened with your key.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a draft campaign. Deploying and staking it are a signer's acts in the console, not tools.

name.description: URL-safe; part of every deployed link; permanent.

pacing.description: Pacing in minutes; omit for none

attributes.description: Querystring pairs appended to every click

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Create a destination link: a target URL plus querystring attributes.
